title: Explicit Predictable Compensators for Single Jump Processes with Initial Information
summary: We study the predictable compensators of stochastic processes in a single jump filtration augmented with initial information represented by a sub-$σ$-algebra $\mathcal{H}$. We consider adapted càdlàg processes of finite variation and give an explicit construction of their predictable compensators. The main difficulty arises when the jump size has a heavy tail and lacks integrability, so that the classical Doob-Meyer decomposition does not apply.
